<tabber>Permanent Achievements=
{{Achievement|Fierce Protection|png|Complete the [[Brooklyn 10-10]] job on the Mayhem difficulty or above.}}
{{Achievement|Vengeful Rain|png|Complete the [[Brooklyn 10-10]] job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.}}
{{Achievement|Valkyries|png|Complete the [[Brooklyn 10-10]] job on the One Down difficulty.}}
{{Achievement|Apartment Sniper|png|Complete the [[Brooklyn 10-10]] job from start, by having all team members using [[:Category:Sniper Rifles|Sniper Rifles]] and the [[OVE9000]] saws on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.}}
{{Achievement|A Rendezvous with Destiny|png|On the [[Brooklyn 10-10]] job, reach [[Charon]] within 6 minutes on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#John Wick Heists Pack|Lady Liberty]]" mask, "[[Materials#John Wick Heists Pack|Underground Neon]]" material and "[[Patterns#John Wick Heists Pack|Baba Yaga]]" pattern.}}
{{Achievement|Pass the Ammo|png|Complete the [[Brooklyn 10-10]] job from start, after deploying 8 [[Ammo bag (Payday 2)|ammo bags]] in the ammo cage on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#John Wick Heists Pack|Birds of Prey]]" mask, "[[Materials#John Wick Heists Pack|Carbon Fiber Weave]]" material and "[[Patterns#John Wick Heists Pack|Hood Stripes]]" pattern.}}
{{Achievement|Hammerhead|png|Complete [[The Yacht Heist]] job on the Mayhem difficulty or above.}}
{{Achievement|Great White|png|Complete [[The Yacht Heist]] job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.}}
{{Achievement|Leviathan|png|Complete [[The Yacht Heist]] job on the Death Sentence difficulty with the One Down mechanic activated.}}
{{Achievement|Thalassophobia|png|Complete [[The Yacht Heist]] job within 6 minutes, on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.}}
{{Achievement|Pacifish|png|Complete [[The Yacht Heist]] job without killing anyone. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#John Wick Heists Pack|Sailor]]" mask, "[[Materials#John Wick Heists Pack|Neon Blue]]" material and "[[Patterns#John Wick Heists Pack|Hotel Pattern]]" pattern.}}
{{Achievement|Blood in the Water|png|Complete [[The Yacht Heist]] job after having killed every security guard on the boat. Unlocks the "[[Masks (Payday 2)#John Wick Heists Pack|Captain]]" mask, "[[Materials#John Wick Heists Pack|Black Suede]]" material and "[[Patterns#John Wick Heists Pack|Continental]]" pattern.}}

|-|Trivia=
*'''{{w|Hammerhead shark|Hammerhead}}''' and '''{{w|Great white shark|Great White}}''' are species of {{w|shark}}s.
*'''{{w|Leviathan}}''' is a sea monster originating from the {{w|Hebrew Bible}}.
